verdict.rationale: Fellow documents recording with a visible bot that joins the meeting (fellow-docs-11/20), which gives some implicit in-meeting presence. It also documents organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded (fellow-docs-12/54/80), a generic admin control that could plausibly govern disclosure. However, the same docs promote bot-less desktop capture, and nothing explicitly describes consent notifications, disclosure messages, or admin-enforced transparency settings. Missing for 10: documented participant notifications (pre-meeting emails or chat messages), an explicit in-meeting recording disclosure or consent prompt, admin enforcement that requires disclosure or blocks silent bot-less recording, and independent corroboration.
